title: Oven Roasted Norwegian Broccoli Roast
description: A kid-friendly Norwegian dish featuring roasted purple-sprouting-broccoli and nuka-pickle, perfect for a satvik-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Spread the broccoli mixture out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the broccoli in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until it is tender and slightly browned.
While the broccoli is roasting, mix the chopped nuka-pickle with lemon juice in a small bowl.
After the broccoli has roasted for 15 minutes, remove it from the oven and toss it with the nuka-pickle mixture until the broccoli is evenly coated.
Return the broccoli to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 5 minutes, or until the broccoli is slightly caramelized.
Remove the broccoli from the oven and serve it hot.
Garnish with additional lemon wedges if desired.
